title: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate?
question:
What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Execellence Rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; complete address has Street, City, State, Zip code

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_048 AS Street, s.XCL_050 AS City, s.XCL_051 AS Zip, s.XCL_052 AS State
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
WHERE t.XCL_036 > 0
ORDER BY (t.XCL_040 * 1.0) / t.XCL_036 ASC
LIMIT 1;
